islands.name: Credit Kingdom
islands.description: Spiral organ shore — Interest Keep weighs on-time history vs haste. Recover score artifacts, dodge interest storms, rebuild trust. Ruins are scenery; the Keep is the test.

learning_objectives: Understand how credit scores are calculated
Learn responsible borrowing and debt management
Compare loan types: secured vs unsecured, fixed vs variable
provenance.originality_notes: Theme: ruined jungle temples as metaphors for damaged credit (not a bank sim). Verb: recover artifacts on a Fortune Party board with rival captains. Structure: chance + skill minigames teaching credit repair. Canon name: Credit Kingdom (Story Bible Ordeal).

areas.name: Ruined Gate
areas.description: Mossy pillars and a cracked credit obelisk. Your compass points deeper.

areas.name: Score Vault
areas.description: Stone tablets etched with payment histories. Touch them carefully.

areas.name: Debt Canyon
areas.description: Echoes of interest. The Collector patrols these ledges.

npcs.name: Rex the Collector
npcs.tagline: Payment plans vs panic — ally against the storm

npcs.name: The Debt Collector
npcs.tagline: Ultimate Ordeal villain — Bank of Obligation

items.name: Credit Shard
items.description: A fragment of on-time payment history.

items.name: Canyon Seal
items.description: Proof you faced interest in the canyon — and chose a payment plan over panic.

quests.title: First Recovery
quests.description: Archivist Cleo opens the Ordeal. Clear Credit Inbox, then weigh signals in Debt Canyon with Rex — the wait-vs-haste Take comes after you practice, not before.

nodes.speaker: Cleo the Archivist
nodes.text: These ruins remember every late payment. Recover shards, keep your Emergency Ledger ready, and never ignore The Debt Collector — interest feeds on haste.

nodes.speaker: Cleo the Archivist
nodes.text: Practice first — Clear the Credit Inbox, then weigh signals with Rex in Debt Canyon. The wait-vs-haste Ordeal that stains Harbor comes after you can read the spiral — not as an opening quiz.

nodes.speaker: Cleo the Archivist
nodes.text: Watch your pouch. Chance spaces cut deeper here.

nodes.speaker: Rex the Collector
nodes.text: The Debt Collector owns these ledges. Interest doesn't yell — it compounds. Weigh on-time history against utilization spikes. Panic sorts bills; a signal read shrinks his grip.

choices.text: I'll run Score Scanner — weigh the spiral.

nodes.speaker: Rex the Collector
nodes.text: Score Scanner opens on the Debt Anvil. Weigh the signals — then talk to me again. The Ordeal choice that stains Harbor waits until after practice.

nodes.speaker: Rex the Collector
nodes.text: You felt the signals. Now the Ordeal choice — it stains Harbor. Wait and rebuild with on-time shards, or rush a high-APR loan for speed?

choices.text: Wait and rebuild — no rush loan.

effects.label: Waited instead of rushing a loan

choices.text: Rush the loan — I need speed.

nodes.speaker: Rex the Collector
nodes.text: Patience is a credit signal. Harbor will keep “Waited the spiral” on the Memory Plinth — and this seal proves you faced the canyon without feeding the storm.

nodes.speaker: Rex the Collector
nodes.text: Speed has a price. Harbor will keep the haste mark — fog follows you home. The seal still proves you entered his canyon; rebuild starts now.

nodes.speaker: Rex the Collector
nodes.text: Your Ordeal already stains the Plinth. Interest still compounds — keep reading signals before you rush.

nodes.speaker: Rex the Collector
nodes.text: The Bank of Obligation waits. Come back when you're ready to weigh the spiral — then choose.

nodes.speaker: The Debt Collector
nodes.text: BANK OF OBLIGATION. Pay in full. Or else. Default is not an option.

choices.text: I rebuild trust — I don't feed interest haste.

nodes.speaker: The Debt Collector
nodes.text: Interest grows. Freedom shrinks. Rex teaches plans — I collect what panic leaves behind. Prove patience in the canyon, Voyager.

nodes.speaker: The Debt Collector
nodes.text: Hidden fees wait. Collateral keeps. One bad deal becomes a lifetime chain.

minigames.name: Credit Inbox
minigames.description: Diegetic messages about loans, APR, and late fees — choose the path that rebuilds score.

minigames.name: Debt Loadout
minigames.description: Balance payments across debts before interest compounds in the canyon.

minigames.name: Score Scanner
minigames.description: Debt Anvil skill test — weigh on-time history vs utilization spikes before the Ordeal Take.
